item.tib: spyi spungs gsang ba thugs kyi brnag pa dbal gsas go cha'i srung ba
item.coloph: 'chi med yum sras gshen gsum gyi lung don/ dbal bon stag la me 'bar gyi phyag len lha klu mi gsum snang mdog bzhi la brgyud/ des lha klu gshen gsum/ des zhang zhung gi gshen gsum/ des rgya bod gshen gsum/ des phram bod zhang zhung gshen gsum/ des se sde me nyag gsum/ des bla chen dran pa nam mkha' la/ des dmu tsa gyer med la'o/ mu tsug smar ro//
